title: The Fable
description:
A fabled genius at killing resides somewhere hidden in Tokyo. Taught since childhood to obey the orders of his boss, he is ordered to live in Osaka as a normal person for one year in order for the boss to lay low.

**Won the 41st Kodansha Manga Award for General Manga in 2017.**
___
**Alt Official English:** [K MANGA](https://kmanga.kodansha.com/title/10055/episode/323851) - United States, Japan, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, Hong Kong, Taiwan, India, Mexico, and Brazil only.
